t: Taming CSS in FastHTML: AST-Powered Helper Scripts in Python
s: This technical article details a developer's strategy to refactor complex CSS in a Python web project ('Pipulate') by leveraging AST-powered Python scripts. The goal is an '80/20' win: consolidating inline styles into semantic CSS classes and utility classes for improved maintainability and consistency, while avoiding 'class hell'.
sub: CSS refactoring in Python web development
Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) for style analysis
Consolidating inline styles into CSS classes
Developing utility classes from common declarations
Refining Python constants for style management
